sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Search by frame: read captions/hashtags, mirrored retry, honest confidence

Short-video screenshots are cropped to vertical, often mirrored and covered
with UI, so trace.moe returns confident wrong matches. Now:
- text on the screenshot is recognised (Vision) and searched on Shikimori
  (which matches partial names such as character names), then mapped to
  AnimeLib; shown first as 'По тексту на скриншоте'
- weak matches are retried with a mirrored frame and the better result kept
- matches under 87% are labelled uncertain with an explanation
